text.tspan: spaces with the people who use them.
A FICTIONAL PRACTICE. A WORKING IDENTITY SYSTEM.
THE MARK / TWO FORMS. ONE SHARED SPACE.
Two F forms face one another, one rotated
through 180 degrees. Their shared grid joins
Field and Form in a single, balanced symbol.
Use the symbol alone below a 120 px lockup.
COLOUR / THE FIELD, NOT THE DECORATION
carries the words. Field anchors the
Starting proportions, not a quota. Use one dominant
field per composition. Never give all four colours
Text pairs: Ink / Paper, Paper / Field, Ink / Lime.
Recheck contrast after changing colours. Keep Lime off
MASTER: sRGB HEX. CONVERT WITH THE PRINTER’S ICC PROFILE; APPROVE A PHYSICAL PROOF.
Start with the people who live here.
Listen first. Draw what comes next.
A six-column grid. A generous edge.
REPEAT THE SYMBOL. KEEP ITS COUNTERFORMS OPEN.
Eye-level spaces, people in context, natural light, honest
materials. Keep verticals straight and colour restrained.
No empty luxury interiors or staged handshakes.
Align left. Work in multiples of 8. Keep text off busy images. Crop the graphic motif, never the identifying logo.
Thank you for walking the site with us. Your
notes about shade, access and places to sit are
now part of the next drawing.
We will bring the revised plan to the open
ARTWORK STUDIES / A4 LETTERHEAD / 85 × 55 mm CARD / UNCOATED STOCK, NO GLOSS
CAMPAIGN / AN INVITATION TO TAKE PART
Bring your ideas for the neighbourhood.
Lead with the public benefit. Keep the time and place
visible. One message, one action; no logo wallpaper behind
DESKTOP & COMPACT LAYOUT STUDIES / PRESERVE MARGINS BEFORE SHRINKING TYPE
Use the vector master. Check 16 px and monochrome.
Recheck contrast and long names after tuning.
Embed fonts for export. Proof print colour and bleed.
Keep the legal name, URL and contact details verified.
